title: JSLH Grade 7 Mathematics Term 2 Revision Draft
contentStatus: draft; partial set; not connected to learner-centre production bank
sourceBasis: Original JSLH questions aligned to the Grade 7 2027 Mathematics Term 2 scheme: algebraic expressions and simple equations; length, mass and capacity; time and temperature; angles and plane figures; perimeter and area.
mcq: Like terms have the same variable part. Add 4 + 3 and subtract 2 to obtain 5a.
Find the value of 3x + 5 when x = 4.
Which expression represents 'six less than twice n'?
Twice n is 2n; six less than this is 2n − 6.
A parcel has a mass of 2.75 kg. What is this mass in grams?
How many millilitres are in 1.25 litres?
A lesson starts at 10:35 a.m. and lasts 45 minutes. When does it end?
From 10:35 to 11:00 is 25 minutes; 20 minutes remain, giving 11:20 a.m.
The temperature rises from 18°C to 27°C. What is the increase?
An obtuse angle is greater than 90° and less than 180°.
Two angles on a straight line are 68° and x°. Find x.
Angles on a straight line add up to 180°; x = 180° − 68° = 112°.
Which quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
A trapezium has one pair of parallel sides under the usual school definition.
A rectangle is 8 cm long and 5 cm wide. Its perimeter is:
Find the area of a triangle with base 10 cm and perpendicular height 6 cm.
Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 10 × 6 = 30 cm².
structured: Simplify 7p − 3p + 2q − q. Show the collection of like terms.
Collect p terms: 7p − 3p = 4p (1 mark). Collect q terms: 2q − q = q (1 mark). Final answer 4p + q (1 mark).
A number is multiplied by 4 and then 7 is added. The result is 31. Form an equation and find the number.
Let the number be x (1). Equation 4x + 7 = 31 (1). Subtract 7: 4x = 24 (1). Divide by 4: x = 6 (1).
A ribbon is 3.45 m long. Convert its length into centimetres and millimetres.
A container holds 2 litres 350 millilitres of water. Express the capacity in millilitres. If 875 ml is poured out, how much remains?
2 litres = 2 000 ml (1); total = 2 350 ml (1); remaining = 2 350 − 875 = 1 475 ml (2).
A bus leaves at 08:47 and arrives at 11:12. Calculate the journey time.
08:47 to 09:00 = 13 minutes (1); 09:00 to 11:00 = 2 hours (1); 11:00 to 11:12 = 12 minutes (1); total = 2 hours 25 minutes (1).
An angle on a straight line is divided into two parts. One part is 3x° and the other is 60°. Find x.
Angles on a straight line total 180° (1); 3x + 60 = 180 (1); 3x = 120 (1); x = 40 (1).
A rectangular garden measures 12 m by 7 m. Find its perimeter and area.
Perimeter = 2(12 + 7) = 38 m (2); area = 12 × 7 = 84 m² (2). Units must be correct.
A triangular sign has a base of 18 cm and a perpendicular height of 9 cm. Calculate its area. Explain why the perpendicular height is used.
Area = ½ × 18 × 9 = 81 cm² (2); the height is the perpendicular distance from the base to the opposite vertex (1); correct square units (1).
